description: Find valet operators within a given radius of a coordinate, ranked by listing tier then distance. Use this when you have a coordinate and an event-context radius (5mi single venue, 25mi metro, 50mi regional). radius_miles is required; empty array if no matches.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). Range: -90 to 90.

limit.description: Max results to return; default 10, capped at 50

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). Range: -180 to 180.

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles. REQUIRED, no default. Pick based on context: 5 mi for a single venue, 25 mi for a metro, 50 mi for a regional sweep.

service.description: Optional service narrowing. One of the 9 canonical valet service slugs. Omit to list every operator within radius regardless of services offered.

name: valet_find_operators_near

indexed_at.description: ISO timestamp of the freshest row in the batch

operators.description: Operators within radius_miles of the input coordinate, ranked tier:desc then distance:asc. Empty array means no matches within radius.

description_text.description: Plain-text summary; null if not on file

distance_miles.description: Distance from the input coordinate to operator HQ, rounded to 1 decimal

phone.description: Operator phone number, null if not on file

primary_city_name.description: Display name of operator HQ city

primary_state_name.description: Display name of operator HQ state

services.description: Canonical service slugs this operator offers

slug.description: Canonical kebab-case operator slug; pass to valet_get_operator for details

title: Find Operators Near
